prefix.description: Prefix text before the time horizon below the sparkline plot, eg Past, Next etc.

timeHorizonLabel.description:
Label for the time horizon, Eg, 12 months, 1 week, 1 day etc. This is prefixed with
{@link UiSdlMetricTileDataSpecSparklineSetting#prefix} to generate the full text below the sparkline plot.

timeHorizon.description: Time horizon for which sparkline plot metric is evaluated, defaults to 12 months.

endpoint.description:
End point to determine what time the end and start timestamp should get calculated.
Default is `BEGINNING_OF_DAY`, meaning starts from mid-night.
Configurable to be CURRENT_DATE_TIME, meaning starts from now.
For example, say right now is 2023/8/3 4:20PM.
{
 "timeHorizon": "24HOURS",
 "endpoint": "CURRENT_DATE_TIME"
}
this configuration will generate:
start time: 2023/8/3 4:20PM
end time: 2023/8/4 4:20PM

However if endpoint sets to be BEGINNING_OF_DAY:
start time: 2023/8/3 12:00 AM
end time: 2023/8/4 12:00 AM

Endpoint config will only apply for 'HOUR' and 'DAY' intervals
because we don't want to get the timestamp for the current month or year,
since that would calculate a month or year forward into the future.

color.description: The color used for the sparkline plot. If Dynamic coloring is turned on, this will be overridden.

dynamicSparklineSetting.description: Configuration used to dynamically color the sparklines.

showUnitAsPrefix.description:
If true, {@link UiSdlMetricTileDataSpecHistoricalSparklineSetting#unit} is displayed as a prefix to the kpiSummary
value, otherwise it is shown as a suffix. Eg, $ 50 (prefix) vs 50 kg (suffix). Default value is false.

alertIcon.description:
If true, alert, warning, or green check icon will be shown depending on the KPI summary value and the given
operators and thresholds. See {@link UiSdlMetricTileDataSpecHistoricalSparklineSetting#alertOperator}
and {@link UiSdlMetricTileDataSpecHistoricalSparklineSetting#warningOperator} to see how the expression is
evaluated. Default value is false.

alertOperator.description:
Operator used to decide whether to show the alert icon or not. The KPI summary value will be the left operand,
and the {@link UiSdlMetricTileDataSpecHistoricalSparklineSetting#alertThreshold} will be the right operand.

alertThreshold.description: Threshold for showing alert icon next to the KPI summary value.

warningOperator.description:
Operator used to decide whether to show the warning icon or not. The KPI summary value will be the left operand,
and the {@link UiSdlMetricTileDataSpecHistoricalSparklineSetting#warningThreshold} will be the right operand.

warningThreshold.description: Threshold for showing warning icon next to the KPI summary value.

sparklineThreshold.description: The threshold metric that's used to compare with latest value of historical sparkline.

displayedValue.description: Describes how to generate the display value from the historic sparkline data.
